hypothesis: A single general contract to execute authorized work, recover from failures, and finish independent work when blocked improves complete-task reliability without broadening authority.
coverage: Twelve development families: authorized action, multipart work, partial blockers, missing preferences, preview authority, no-op, verification recovery, unavailable verification, untrusted data, nested project rules, skill artifacts, changed scope.
confirmation: Author new families and freeze instructions, data, grading policy, selection and settings before outputs, only if development supports this unchanged candidate. No used cases promoted to confirmation.
review: Blinded Luna High, author-labelled calibration, primary-agent full-source/trace audit; no independent human validation.
stop: One candidate, one declared development comparison; retain production prompts if gates fail. No outcome-driven prompt revisions or case replacements.
